newsitem.title: CUBA: Cuba calls Manley's death a loss for region.
newsitem.headline: Cuba calls Manley's death a loss for region.

text.p: Cuba said on Friday the death of Jamaica's former prime minister, Michael Manley, was a "sad loss" not just for Jamaica but for the Caribbean and Latin America.
Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Marianela Ferriol, speaking at a regular weekly briefing, said the Cuban government would be sending a message of condolence to Manley's family.
Manley, prime minister of Jamaica from 1972 until 1980 and again from 1989 to 1992, died on Thursday night at the age of 72 after a long battle with prostate cancer.
He was a longtime ally of Cuban President Fidel Castro and a leader in many Third World causes, including liberation efforts in Africa.
